name: ContentProtection
description: Content-protection read path for FreeInk: rights parsing, content-key unwrap, and decrypt-on-read for protected EPUBs. Parser-agnostic (works with CrossPoint's Epub or FreeInkBook). Legitimate client behavior only: books stay encrypted at rest, decryption is on-read into memory, loan expiry enforced. Opt-in crypto backend via -DFREEINK_CONTENT_WOLFSSL=1 plus a wolfSSL lib_dep.
keywords: epub, ebook, decrypt, rights, protected, lcp
notes: Inflate provider: define CONTENT_EXTERNAL_MINIZ to bind to the host application's already-linked miniz (no second copy in the image); omit it to compile the vendored content_-prefixed copy for standalone host tests.
